items.question: What is Vezham?
items.answer: Vezham is a vector-asset library with UI icons, SVG illustrations, and brand logos. This browser uses the pinned @vezham/icons@1.0.7 CDN runtime for icons, alongside the existing illustration and logo collections.

items.question: Is Vezham completely free?
items.answer: Yes, Vezham is 100% free and open-source under the MIT License. Use it in personal, commercial, education, or open-source projects — no attribution required (though always appreciated!).

items.question: Can I use it in commercial projects?
items.answer: Absolutely. Commercial use is fully allowed. Bundle Vezham into templates, websites, SaaS products, or mobile apps — even ones you charge for.

items.question: What grid size is used?
items.answer: Every icon is drawn on a strict 24×24 pixel grid with predefined baseline strokes. This guarantees the icons stay pixel-perfect and sharp at any size, from 12px to large header formats.

items.question: How are weights handled?
items.answer:
Vezham does not auto-generate weights. Each is handcrafted:
- outline: Clean stroked paths (default 1.5px). Customizable via the strokeWidth prop.
- filled: Custom solid silhouettes designed to match their outline counterparts for smooth state transitions.
- duotone-outline and duotone-filled: Two-color variants for layered emphasis and richer states.

items.question: Does it support tree-shaking?
items.answer: Yes! All packages — @vezham/icons-react, @vezham/icons-react-native, @vezham/icons-vue, and @vezham/icons-svelte — are bundled as ES modules and declare "sideEffects": false. Modern bundlers (Vite, Webpack, Rollup, Metro) automatically include only the icons you actually import.

items.question: Is there a Figma library?
items.answer: Yes! A community Figma file with all vector master components is maintained. Search for "Vezham" in the Figma Community to duplicate the official file and design with the same visual assets.

items.question: How do I request a new icon?
items.answer: Open an Issue on our GitHub Issues tracker using the "Icon Request" template. We review requests weekly and design new sets based on popularity.

items.question: How do I contribute?
items.answer: We love contributions! You can help with code, type definitions, package updates, or new SVG icons. Read our contributing guide in the GitHub repository, fork the codebase, and open a Pull Request.
